name: Mantle of the Ancients — static boost after the enters trigger
notes: Memory: project_mantle_ancients_boost_after_trigger_2026-06-04. The static boost line followed a trigger line and was wrongly skipped, so the Aura had no effects at all. Here Mantle and Bonesplitter are both attached to Grizzly Bears: Mantle gives +1/+1 per attached Aura/Equipment (2), Bonesplitter +2/+0, so 2+2+2 / 2+2 = 6/4.
